solutions.latex:
$20$ revolutions $= 90$ seconds

$20$ revolutions $= \dfrac{90}{60 \times 60}$ hours

$\dfrac{20 \times 60 \times 60}{90}$ revolutions $= 1$ hour

$800$ revolutions $= 1$ hour

Parabola is symmetrical. Axis of symmetry is $x = 30$.

$A = 60x - x^2 = 60 \times 30 - 30^2 = 900\ \text{m}^2$

Interest free period $= 60$ days

$\therefore$ Interest charged for 15 days

$I = 950 \times 0.034\% \times 15 \approx \$4.85$

$S = V_0(1 - r)^n$

$1500 = 5000(1 - 0.20)^n$

$(1 - 0.20)^n = \dfrac{1500}{5000}$

$0.80^n < 0.3$

$n > 6$ (trial and error)

$\therefore$ In 2025 the air conditioner will be below \$1500

18 months $= 6$ quarters

$5.4\%$ p.a. $= 1.35\%$ per quarter

$\therefore A = 26000 \times (1 + 1.35\%)^6 = 26000 \times (1.0135)^6$

275 gm is 1 standard deviation above the mean. Hence, 275 gm has a $z$-score of 1.

$P(z > 1) = 50\% - 34\% = 16\% = 0.16$

$P(X < 260) = P\left(Z < \dfrac{260 - 270}{5}\right) = P(Z < -2) = \dfrac{1}{2}(1 - 95\%) = 2.5\% = 0.025$

$800 \times 0.025 = 20$

so approximately 20 packets per hour are under 260 grams and will need to be repackaged.

$20 \times 14 = 280$

so approximately 280 packets per day are under 260 grams and will need to be repackaged.

notes: Mathematics Standard 2 trial (William Clarke College), bundled worked solutions on pages 24-34 (0-based). Section I Q1-15 (15 marks), Section II Q16-40 (85 marks); totals match cover. Page indices are 0-based (printed page n = index n-1). Q22(b) printed '26.9-' with a line break before 'cents/kWh'; transcribed as '26.9 cents/kWh'. Q38 table has a blank cell for row D, column B (printed blank where '50' would be expected by symmetry with B-D; the table's B row shows '–' for D); the guidelines' graph has no B-D edge, so the blank is left as printed. Q24 stem mixes 'them' and 'her' as printed. Q26 diagram labels activity K as lowercase 'k'. Q35(b) solution gives '158 L' although the question states no units. Solution for Q16(b) and Q39(b) use approximate graph readings. Q25(d) solution accepts 240 m or 250 m. No unrelated-part splits were needed (all lettered parts share a stem or data). Q20 and Q24/Q33/Q38/Q1 tables stored as table data; all other figures cropped.
